## Project Overview

This project will focus on how the non-citizen incarceration in the United States over the past 26 years (2000–2026). The research aims to find out how incarceration trends have changed and whether these patterns vary based on immigration status. The research will categorize populations into undocumented migrants, legal permanent residents, and asylum seekers. Additionally, this project will evaluate whether the onset of the Covid-19 Pandemic in 2020 served as a factor for significant changes in incarceration rates.
